errors.text_span: The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered from largest to smallest in a clockwise direction. Starting from the largest slice (Open-Answer, 63.0%), the next slice clockwise is the smallest (True-False, 4.1%).

errors.text_span: A legend identifying the answer types is included below the chart.
errors.evidence: There is no legend below the chart. The text 'Answer Types' is a title. The labels for each category are positioned next to their respective slices, effectively serving as the legend.
The description completely omits the right-hand panel of the figure, which is labeled 'Examples' and provides an example of each of the three question types mentioned in the pie chart.

The description fails to mention the absolute counts for each answer type, which are provided in parentheses next to each label on the chart: True-False (16), Multiple-Choice (127), and Open-Answer (244).
